reviews.author: S Ward
reviews.text: I bought a brand new tire from Sam’s Club in Jacksonville that only made it to about a half an hour before blowing out. I got a time estimate of 45min-1hour and my driver was there in less than a half an hour. He was courteous and professional, and let me know which tire places were nearby and their availability. Every tire shop was closed. This tow truck driver happened to have the same size tire that I needed, he also realized my valve stem was broken (and he repaired it after midnight and he got me back on the road. He went so far as to let me know which other towing companies were just as good in case I ever needed another tow and he wasn’t able to be reached. Great service, great price, and outstanding work.

reviews.author: Latricia Daniels
reviews.text: I just want to thank Mr Brandon Perry himself for the the service and and the help that he provided me in my time of need. I appreciate you to the fullest and your tow truck driver also. Keep rocking and continuing to do what you do.

reviews.author: Courtney Santiago
reviews.text: Used my insurance to try to get a tow from these guys a few weeks ago, there should not be a charge for a tow. First after waiting couple hours I was told that they would need $100 out of pocket because the price they agreed upon with the insurance company was not enough for them. Insurance company advised me that they talked to them and let them know that they are supposed to speak directly to the insurance company when there is a discrepancy with the price. Not the customer. Insurance called me back later to finish setting up the tow again with them, and this time I was told by my insurance company it would be $200 out of pocket. I am 100% all ears if somebody would like to make that make sense.

reviews.author: Patty Kelsey
reviews.text: I can’t thank Bobby enough!! I was literally stranded, what would have been for hours! He saved me!!! Great company !! I will definitely recommend you to friends and family ! THANK YOU BOBBY! I appreciate you!

reviews.author: Holly Oates-Barker
reviews.text: My ignition switch on my car wouldn’t turn to crank this morning so I needed a tow. Honestly, I just chose this place at random, but I’m so glad I did! I called and Brandon was absolutely wonderful. We reviewed all of the car info and pricing. I gave him my credit card info and he texted me my receipt while we were still on the phone! Then the tow truck operator, Bobby, called me soon after to verify all the info and coordinate the pick up of my vehicle. Later on, I made a follow up call to Bobby in the afternoon just to make sure everything went okay with the drop off. He let me know exactly where he dropped my car, and even sent photos of where it was parked AND him putting the key in the dropbox. It’s so nice that they document that process so you feel good knowing your car made it safely to its drop off. I have never needed a tow truck before, but if I ever do again I will definitely be calling Castle Hayne Towing!

reviews.author: Brady Wulf
reviews.text: Brandon and his driver Bobby were able to help us at 9PM on Thanksgiving after the insurance provider canceled their service. They were amazing to work with.

reviews.author: Lee Ann Swanekamp
reviews.text: My son’s car was totaled in an accident. Not only did Castle Hayne do a great job taking care of the car, but they also helped my son understand a lot about what steps he needed to take next. Brandon was especially helpful coordinating an appointment when my son had to get his license plate over the weekend when the lot wasn’t open. They helped with a lot more than just towing. Classy operation.

reviews.author: Megan Burrows
reviews.text: I cannot speak enough to the level of customer service and professionalism that Bobby exhibited. He was prompt, kind, compassionate, and professional. He went above and beyond to help us out, and we felt very secure that our car was being well taken care of. Thank you! Should we ever need tow services again, this will be the only place we will call!

reviews.author: Ashley Lopez
reviews.text: Our boat trailer tire exploded on the highway when we were heading home.. Thank y'all for saving us on a Labor Day! Especially when people were closed on Labor Day. Trying to find a solution for us and we left the next day with no problems. You guys have great service! Thank you so much to Bobby who came to rescue us. He was very kind to us. Thank you. Thank you. I 100% recommend this place!

reviews.author: Ashby Whitehorne
reviews.text: Brandon is one of a kind! He went above and beyond for me to retrieve my car! I was on and off the phone with him all day on a Sunday and he was so helpful, patient and knowledgeable. He really helped me in a tough situation and am so glad people like him in this industry exist! Bobby who delivered my car was so friendly too and really helped me make light of a bad situation. Thank you guys! I appreciate your integrity and honesty.

reviews.author: Josephine Pierce
reviews.text: Brandon was extremely helpful and kind. Very reasonable prices and willing to go the extra mile to help clients. Will definitely recommend and use them in the future for any towing needs!

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.text: BOBBY AND THE OWNER BRANDON- best of the best- customer service is top notch and they are QUICK ! It is Thanksgiving night and we hit a curb downtown and popped the tire - beyond repair … after dealing with 3rd party FIMC company being the WORST - Brandon and Bobby still got us taken care of. 10/10 recommend!!!

reviews.author: Mackenzie Simmons
reviews.text: Awful, horrible, and disgusting people! Called them to help tow my truck from the side of the highway with a blown tire, the driver drove right past me and never stopped, then when I called the office and told them the driver passed me the office guy argued with me about it and tried to charge me a second time for someone to come back. Said screw you I’ll figure something else out, then caught them showing up 6 hours later trying to steal my truck!!! The driver was disgusting looked like he just crawled out of the bottom of the Cape Fear river and he had a lot lizard sitting in his truck with him. And they still charged me $150 for absolutely nothing! Save yourself and call Wayne’s Towing instead!!!!

reviews.author: Ann Brown
reviews.text: I am totally amazed how Bobby and Brandon helped me when they towed and repaired my car. Bobby has worked on my car before. He quickly finds the problem and does excellent repairs. They are truly unselfish, compassionate people. They put me as a person before money. The saying goes “wanna see how people really are? Wait until money is involved”.Bobby and Brandon both showed, without a doubt, that they are honest Christian people. THE BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE I HAVE EVER SEEN. And I have seen a lot in 72 years.

reviews.author: Juliann Hayes
reviews.text: I got a flat tire at 11:30pm and Bobby was more than understanding and helpful to come out and help me for a very fair price, I highly recommend this place for any care issues or tire changes you need!

reviews.author: Leah Versola Kallam
reviews.text: Brandon was very helpful and worked with me to get the best offer on my old truck, fast towing service as soon as possible, and made the whole process easy and comfortable.

reviews.author: Jala Hobley
reviews.text: Towed my car the tow truck man Dropped my car off at the mechanic any kind of way left the car in neutral killed my whole battery and the man that I spoke to to make the payment. They just seem like they care about money. I would never use this company again. Bobby was the man who towed my car

reviews.author: Donna Simpson
reviews.text: Started calling around 5 am and at first had to cancel because the price quoted was different from what I was told. I truly appreciate the call back and prompt service especially since I waited two hours for another popular place that never showed up. Bobby the driver was very friendly and even offered to take me to the bank. He went above and beyond!!! I will use them again. Great Customer Service!!!

reviews.author: Derek Ellis
reviews.text: Hands down best towing service in town. Really helped me and offered solutions for my blown motor. Good people, good business. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: David Sand
reviews.text: What a great company. Had a flat tire and no spare. They picked me up within 10mins and we're totally willing to work with me. They found me a tire shop close by and hooked me up with a great deal to get me there. Thank you so much and hope I don't need you in the future but if I do, I have you on speed dial. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Robin Frazier
reviews.text: We broke down 3 hours from home on a Saturday evening. Within 30 minutes of calling them a truck was at our location. The driver Bobby & Ashley were great and got us home with no problems. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: carolyn kouryhill
reviews.text: Very nice tow truck company. We worked with Jason and he was very nice and even called us to let us know about our car. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Emmanuel Boston
reviews.text: Give Bobby the most he was patient and thorough on his job respect to Bobby and Castle Hayne towing are great to have him!!! Thank you Bobby

reviews.author: Joel Sanchez
reviews.text: WARNING THE OWNER AND HIS WORKER ARE BOTH SCAMMERS, read other recent reviews, -(they will take advantage of customers ) I called these guys to tow my car after i hydroplaned on the highway, they said they could tow my car to my location for $300. Instead they made up a story saying that the Highway patrol instructed them to impound my car and proceeded to charge me $600 to release it from impound and $300 for the tow. I called the highway patrol and they have no record of requesting an impound. They tried to over charge me for work that required special equipment to retrieve the car, but when I talked to the patrol officer that was on scene he said that no such equipment was used. They backed down from the $600 charge after one of the patrol officer got involved. If Anyone has any questions don’t hesitate to contact me via email.

reviews.author: Kemi Simpson
reviews.text: Thank you James for the quick friendly and very professional service. You made the whole car breaking down and towing experience as comfortable as possible and got me and my van back to home safely. I appreciate your courtesy. Highly recommend this company and James to tow your car with care. Thanks again!!

reviews.author: Cole McGuire
reviews.text: I needed my car towed and my driver was Bobby I told him my car was lowered and he handled it with care couldn’t ask for a better price or a better tow.

reviews.author: Dorian Fulcher
reviews.text: Catle Hayne Towing stole my car and scraped it.. My 2000 a8l audi with 22 inch rims and tires, the rims and tires alone valued at $4000 came up .missing from.a shop I had it at. The owner told me Castle Hayne towing towed it off which the owner Brandon denied. I called the police and found out the driver had scraped my car. The detectiveve told me the owner has insurance and was willing to pay me for the car. I called up there and some guy told me my car was a flood car and tried to pay me $500. Run don't walk. Stay clear of this company.

reviews.author: Maggie Croft
reviews.text: Brandon was the one who came and picked up my car, was very helpful through the whole process. Even calling me when there was an issue two months after the car was totalled when there was an issue with insurance to save myself from reprocussions. Great company.

reviews.author: Jarelle Lewis
reviews.text: Got stuck in a ditch pretty badly. They towed me out without flipping the car and did it fairly quickly and affordable.

reviews.author: Maria Naranjo
reviews.text: Bobby and the man who answered the phone were incredibly professional and nice. Today is Thanksgiving and they made the process super seamless. Thank you so much!!!!

reviews.author: Dorian Fulcher
reviews.text: The owner and his worker and the place I had my Audi A8 l towed to fix it stole my car. Scraped my Audi at the junk yard and kept the 22 inch rims. This is a criminal offense, the detective did nothing. Told me they were going to reimburse me for my car. When I called up the worker said it was a flood car. They stole my car. Stey far away from these thiefs

reviews.author: Janice Arnold
reviews.text: I would not recommend them to anyone. They quoted me one price on the phone and charge me a higher price after they pulled my car out of the ditch.have asked repeatedly for a receipt email to me and have not received it yet.

reviews.author: michelle barrow
reviews.text: These guys are great. They are not your average towing service. Highly recommend them. Honest and fair. Thank you

reviews.author: Tom Bennett
reviews.text: Bobby was there fast ... I was not in an easy place to get to. Bobby maneuvered right in.. and winched me out.... and I was on my way. Highly recommend these guys

reviews.author: Collin
reviews.text: These are scam artist. If you have your vehicle towed there they will charge you an arm and a leg, and ransom your vehicle while not even fixing it.

reviews.author: Heidi Fuller
reviews.text: Being involved in an accident is stressful but Castle Hayne Towing was so helpful and reassuring during the process. Brandon was very knowledgeable and kind which I am very grateful. I would definitely recommend this tow lot to anyone in the Wilmington area.

reviews.author: Kindyl Tolson
reviews.text: Ive used this company a couple times and they have been awesome - communicate well, timing and honestly just really nice guys. I appreciate a company with great communication cause having to even call for pricing is already stressful. They did help ease my stress. Pricing was decent. The owner said the driver will call....boom....the driver Bobby calls. Bobby said He will be there in 30-45 minites...boom here comes Bobby in 40 minutes. Even recommended what my next step could be for fixing my car. Couldn't imagine calling another company. Thanks guys!
